name: YAHLP-Public-Basic
description: YAHLP - Yet Another HomeLab Portal - Public Mode with basic Auth Configured for public internet deployment with: - HTTPS with automatic Let's Encrypt certificates - Basic authentication (username/password) - Requires domain name and email address - Ports 80 and 443 must be port-forwarded Setup Requirements: 1. Add DNS A record pointing your domain to your server IP (Seerr, Emby, Plex will need subdomains setup) 2. Ensure ports 80 and 443 are port-forwarded from router 3. Configure basic auth credentials (format: user:pass or user1:pass1|user2:pass2) 4. Set TEST_MODE=false once ready for production to avoid Let's Encrypt rate limiting

paths.name: Configuration
paths.description: Configuration folder - store the yahlp and sites JSON5 files here - ENV Variables override config settings, remove the variable settings from the form. Custom templates in the templates folder

variables.name: Access Mode
variables.description: public=subdomain-based routing with OAuth support (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt); private=folder-based routing with basic auth (HTTP on internal network)

variables.name: Domain (Public)
variables.description: Your domain for public mode (e.g., yahlp.yourdomain.com)

variables.name: Email (Public)
variables.description: Email for Let's Encrypt notifications (public mode only)

variables.name: Let's Encrypt Test Mode
variables.description: Let's Encrypt --dry-run mode (test without rate limits). WARNING: Certificates will NOT be issued. Set to false when ready for production.

variables.name: Dashboard Name
variables.description: Displayed in browser title and dashboard

variables.name: Dashboard Layout

variables.name: Accent Color

variables.name: Dashboard Landing
